author: OldManTigerMask
body:
Introduction
Hi! I'm Tiger and I'm certain the following I'm going to suggest will benefit & help the server's get played.

Player Limit Changes
 
I think my main concern is player Limits on Avicus many of the Nebula Gamemodes are player limits of 40 or more. What I suggest is actually decrease it to 32 players. Before you go, WOAH dude, we want Avicus to grow not go! I am suggesting this so then we can have many other gamemodes being played for example many of the DTM & CTW servers might actually have players on them because during Avicus's peaks it has 80+ Users, so therefor at least 3 servers will actually be played.

So here are the server limits I'd like to see changed:
Throwback - 48 Players (MIN 8)
DTM01 - 32 Players (MIN 6)
DTM02 - 32 Players (MIN 6)
DTM03 - 32 Players (MIN 6)
CTW01 - 24 Players (MIN 4)
TDM - 16 Players (MIN  4)

These will most likely benefit the community and encourage more players to choose other gamemodes instead of just playing ONE set of maps. Also that brings me up to my second point, CTW & TDM might actually get played, generally the reason why CTW & TDM aren't played often is due to the lack of players.

Actually HAVE Player Limits...

Avicus I find does not have real player limits on Nebula Servers. So I suggest actually HAVING a player limit this will make sure games when they are 'full' it will allow users to try out other servers & games they most likely have rarely played.

Conclusion
So Thanks for reading and please feel free to leave feedback of this idea below and any other suggestions that could make this forum suggest better.

Thanks,
Tiger

Also a shoutout to SnowX3 for such an amazing debate on the previous Suggestion I made

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
16 players is a bit too low for CTW but other than that I quite like this idea.

Nebula servers do have player limits, when 1 nebula server is full and the rest are empty it kinda sucks. 

Let's just not decrease it too much that it destroys the map's intended gameplay.
